invariants.rationale: The method always returns the value from IOUtils.runMerge(...), which should produce a non-null iterator.
instantTime is required to identify the commit or update instance, and getUpdateHandle and runMerge use it as input.
fileId identifies which file will be updated/merged and is required by downstream calls.
partitionPath is passed to getUpdateHandle and should not be null for correct operation.
keyToNewRecords contains the records to update and is essential for merge and update operations.
